content: Safety guardrail patterns for automated remediation: idempotence, context-aware constraints, mandatory rollback plans, human-in-the-loop approval for autonomous actions, audit logs, and an abort/escape-hatch to revert to manual. Level-2 partial automation = agent executes with explicit human approval before action, strict action scoping (prefer read-only), rollback mechanisms, real-time monitoring vs expected patterns. Governance trend: autonomy expands only after a given failure class proves reliable under permission boundaries + confidence routing + escalation thresholds (progressive trust, not day-one full autonomy).
